check_red_at_base: quality-harness's declared check (bash scripts/selftest.sh) fails at this commit in the tree bench builds (measured 2026-10-14): lifecycle.test.mjs 'reported: a scratch corpus does not pull the record gates' fails even in a full-history clone, and two orphan-sweep.test.mjs cases that read git history fail in the single-commit tree
instruction: On a large repository, the git calls that list the working tree's changed paths outrun their timeouts. Give the two that list changed paths the 30-second timeout that the ls-files listing in trackedPaths (plugin/scripts/decision-corpus.mjs) already has: the `git status --porcelain -z -uall` call in statusPaths (plugin/scripts/tree-facts.mjs, now 5_000) and the `git diff --name-only --diff-filter=D` call in deletedTrackedPaths (plugin/scripts/artifact-pass.mjs, now 10_000) both become `timeout: 30_000`. In trackedPaths, write the existing `timeout: 30000` as `timeout: 30_000`, so the three read alike. Every other timeout stays as it is, including the git call in gitLines in tree-facts.mjs, whose options are otherwise the same as statusPaths', and the rev-parse call just above the diff in artifact-pass.mjs. Change nothing else.

require.match: 'status', '--porcelain', '-z', '-uall', \.\.\.harnessPathspecs\(root\)\],\n\s*\{ encoding: 'utf8', timeout: 30_000, maxBuffer: GIT_LISTING_BUFFER, windowsHide: true \}\)
'--diff-filter=D', 'HEAD'\],\n\s*\{ encoding: 'utf8', timeout: 30_000, maxBuffer: GIT_LISTING_BUFFER, windowsHide: true \}\)
'core\.quotePath=false', \.\.\.args\],\n\s*\{ encoding: 'utf8', timeout: 30_000, maxBuffer: GIT_LISTING_BUFFER, windowsHide: true \}\)
